# Allowed findings of TestNoInPlaceBinaryWrites (inplace_guard_test.go).
# One per line: <file> <func> <rule>  # reason. A line matching nothing fails the test.

# The one signer. Its codesign -f only ever runs on a temp path (EnsureSigned,
# ResignByReplace, Install, InstallReader and HealOnce in the same package).
internal/binsign/binsign.go Codesign.Sign codesign-force  # k3sm's single signing entry point; callers sign temps only

# The dev builders' Sign seam: it delegates to binsign.Codesign, and pkg/dev calls
# it only on a fresh build in a private temp dir (renamed afterwards) or through
# binsign.EnsureSigned.
pkg/dev/execshim.go goExecShimBuilder.Sign sign-call  # delegates to binsign.Codesign.Sign
pkg/dev/podshims.go clangPodShimBuilder.Sign sign-call  # delegates to binsign.Codesign.Sign
pkg/dev/execshim.go Manager.provisionExecShim sign-call  # signs the fresh build in a private temp dir, before the rename
pkg/dev/execshim.go Manager.provisionRootExecShim sign-call  # signs the fresh build in a private temp dir, before the rename
pkg/dev/podshims.go Manager.buildPodShim sign-call  # signs the fresh build in a private temp dir, before the rename

# Read-only codesign inspections: they read signatures and entitlements, never write.
pkg/install/install_darwin.go darwinSystem.VerifyVirtualizationEntitlement codesign  # codesign -d --entitlements, read-only
pkg/shadow/shadow.go CDHash codesign  # codesign -dvvv, read-only
pkg/shadow/verify.go VerifySignature codesign  # codesign -dvvv and -d --entitlements, read-only

# Not a binary.
pkg/provider/hostprocess.go HostProcess.startPod truncate  # a container log file

# k3sm install builds a whole staged tree and swaps it in with one rename, so the
# shadow copies it signs are fresh clones nothing has mapped yet.
pkg/install/shadow.go makeShadowSet adhocsign  # signs a fresh clone inside the staged tree, before the swap
pkg/install/shadow_darwin.go darwinSystem.AdHocSign adhocsign  # the install System seam over image.AdHocSign; only makeShadowSet calls it
